Johnna Smith - 70 - fears cancer in eye
Page 144 July 26 July 27 Sebastian Colvaruso - 4 - on 3rd day before his birth (4) was in ac- cident. Almost hopeless for 22 weeks. Then was enrolled and parents started back to the Sacraments ... Still slow in convalescing.
Therese Hamlin - six - acts like obsessed - quarrels - with every one .... Mother in almost dispar of what to do ... takes Ist copy of "City of God".
Page 145 July 29 Gaston Vanhaverbeke - 29 - careless for sometime about Church and Sacraments - now in serious trouble.
Mrs. Lillian O'Neill - 55 - Drs.
Aug. 1
1939, August
Robert Multhaler - 15 - bone infection - Operation to remove leg to-morrow, a.m. . Enrolled at 6:50 P.M. To-night.
Thomas Dolan - 8 - of Pontiac - in accident July 17 - pelvic-bone broken and internal injuries - has not been able to take nourishment Mrs. Mary Sink - 76 - Stroke three weeks ago - improving slowly Ruth Mitchell - 28 - nerveous and hard to get along with.
Page 146
Aug. 3 Thanks. . . John Tighe - 54 -
4 Maru Jame Collins (see July 15) lukemia Drs. gave no hope of living more than a few weeks - Parents made promises ... was down to hospital yesterday ... met Jewish doctor who had feared she would be dead by this Saturday ... . Astonishingly improved To-day .... is Enrolled perpet- ually .... Deo Gr.
John Bruin - 69 - of Memphis Mich. cancer of neck .... promises to go back to Sacraments .... is Enrolled To-day
Thanks - Mary Ann Kowell - 5 - brain-tuomer nearly a year when par- ents brought her here to curb-stone and enrolled her ... promising to read "City of God" ... Drs. had lost all hopes of her becoming con- scious. Child here To-day in perfect health. Deo Gratias.
